name: build_secure_exercises_module
query: ALTER TABLE public.exercises ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS chapter_id uuid REFERENCES public.chapters(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS lesson_id uuid REFERENCES public.lessons(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS exercise_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'short_answer', ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS difficulty text, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS content_markdown text, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS correction_markdown text, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_published boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS estimated_duration_minutes integer, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS display_order integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_test_data boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(); DO $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname='exercises_exercise_type_check') THEN ALTER TABLE public.exercises ADD CONSTRAINT exercises_exercise_type_check CHECK (exercise_type IN ('single_choice','multiple_choice','true_false','short_answer','free_response')); END IF; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname='exercises_difficulty_check') THEN ALTER TABLE public.exercises ADD CONSTRAINT exercises_difficulty_check CHECK (difficulty IS NULL OR difficulty IN ('easy','medium','hard')); END IF; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname='exercises_duration_check') THEN ALTER TABLE public.exercises ADD CONSTRAINT exercises_duration_check CHECK (estimated_duration_minutes IS NULL OR estimated_duration_minutes > 0); END IF; END $$; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.exercise_questions (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), exercise_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.exercises(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, question_type text NOT NULL, prompt_markdown text NOT NULL, options jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, correct_answers jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, explanation_markdown text, display_order integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT exercise_questions_type_check CHECK (question_type IN ('single_choice','multiple_choice','true_false','short_answer','free_response')), CONSTRAINT exercise_questions_options_array CHECK (jsonb_typeof(options)='array'), CONSTRAINT exercise_questions_answers_array CHECK (jsonb_typeof(correct_answers)='array')); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.exercise_attempts (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, exercise_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.exercises(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, answers jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'in_progress', score numeric, percentage numeric, total_questions integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, correct_answers integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, incorrect_answers integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, started_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), submitted_at timestamptz, duration_seconds integer, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT exercise_attempts_status_check CHECK (status IN ('in_progress','submitted','review_required')), CONSTRAINT exercise_attempts_answers_object CHECK (jsonb_typeof(answers)='object'), CONSTRAINT exercise_attempts_percentage_check CHECK (percentage IS NULL OR (percentage >= 0 AND percentage <= 100)), CONSTRAINT exercise_attempts_duration_check CHECK (duration_seconds IS NULL OR duration_seconds >= 0)); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS exercises_lesson_active_order_idx ON public.exercises(lesson_id,is_published,is_active,display_order); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS exercises_target_active_order_idx ON public.exercises(level_id,series_id,subject_id,is_published,is_active,display_order); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS exercise_questions_exercise_order_idx ON public.exercise_questions(exercise_id,display_order); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS exercise_attempts_user_exercise_started_idx ON public.exercise_attempts(user_id,exercise_id,started_at DESC); CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_exercise_pedagogical_link() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.lessons l JOIN public.chapters c ON c.id=l.chapter_id JOIN public.course_subject_offerings o ON o.id=c.subject_offering_id WHERE l.id=NEW.lesson_id AND c.id=NEW.chapter_id AND o.subject_id=NEW.subject_id AND o.level_id=NEW.level_id AND o.series_id=NEW.series_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Le rattachement niveau, série, matière, chapitre et leçon de l’exercice est incohérent.'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $$; DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS exercises_validate_pedagogical_link ON public.exercises; CREATE TRIGGER exercises_validate_pedagogical_link BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF subject_id,level_id,series_id,chapter_id,lesson_id ON public.exercises FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.validate_exercise_pedagogical_link(); CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.touch_exercise_rows() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path=public AS $$ BEGIN NEW.updated_at=now(); RETURN NEW; END; $$; DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS exercises_touch_updated_at ON public.exercises; CREATE TRIGGER exercises_touch_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.exercises FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.touch_exercise_rows(); DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS exercise_questions_touch_updated_at ON public.exercise_questions; CREATE TRIGGER exercise_questions_touch_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.exercise_questions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.touch_exercise_rows(); DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS exercise_attempts_touch_updated_at ON public.exercise_attempts; CREATE TRIGGER exercise_attempts_touch_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.exercise_attempts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.touch_exercise_rows(); ALTER TABLE public.exercises ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE public.exercise_questions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE public.exercise_attempts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS select_exercises_authenticated ON public.exercises; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS admin_insert_exercises ON public.exercises; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS admin_update_exercises ON public.exercises; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS admin_delete_exercises ON public.exercises; CREATE POLICY exercises_admin_all ON public.exercises FOR ALL USING (is_edutech_admin()) WITH CHECK (is_edutech_admin()); CREATE POLICY exercises_student_available_read ON public.exercises FOR SELECT USING (is_published IS TRUE AND is_active IS TRUE AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.subjects s ON s.id=exercises.subject_id AND s.is_active IS TRUE JOIN public.chapters c ON c.id=exercises.chapter_id AND c.is_active IS TRUE JOIN public.lessons l ON l.id=exercises.lesson_id AND l.is_active IS TRUE JOIN public.course_subject_offerings o ON o.id=c.subject_offering_id AND o.is_published IS TRUE WHERE p.id=auth.uid() AND p.school_level=(SELECT name FROM public.levels WHERE id=exercises.level_id) AND p.series=(SELECT name FROM public.series WHERE id=exercises.series_id) AND o.subject_id=exercises.subject_id AND o.level_id=exercises.level_id AND o.series_id=exercises.series_id)); CREATE POLICY exercise_questions_admin_all ON public.exercise_questions FOR ALL USING (is_edutech_admin()) WITH CHECK (is_edutech_admin()); CREATE POLICY exercise_attempts_admin_read ON public.exercise_attempts FOR SELECT USING (is_edutech_admin()); CREATE POLICY exercise_attempts_student_read ON public.exercise_attempts FOR SELECT USING (user_id=auth.uid()); CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_access_exercise_for_current_student(p_exercise_id uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$ SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.exercises e JOIN public.subjects s ON s.id=e.subject_id AND s.is_active IS TRUE JOIN public.chapters c ON c.id=e.chapter_id AND c.is_active IS TRUE JOIN public.lessons l ON l.id=e.lesson_id AND l.is_active IS TRUE JOIN public.course_subject_offerings o ON o.id=c.subject_offering_id AND o.is_published IS TRUE JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id=auth.uid() WHERE e.id=p_exercise_id AND e.is_published IS TRUE AND e.is_active IS TRUE AND o.subject_id=e.subject_id AND o.level_id=e.level_id AND o.series_id=e.series_id AND p.school_level=(SELECT name FROM public.levels WHERE id=e.level_id) AND p.series=(SELECT name FROM public.series WHERE id=e.series_id)); $$; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_exercise_catalog(p_subject_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,p_chapter_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,p_lesson_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,p_difficulty text DEFAULT NULL) RETURNS TABLE(exercise_id uuid,title text,statement text,exercise_type text,difficulty text,estimated_duration_minutes integer,display_order integer,subject_name text,chapter_title text,lesson_title text,attempt_count bigint,last_percentage numeric,best_percentage numeric,last_status text) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$ SELECT e.id,e.title,e.statement,e.exercise_type,e.difficulty,e.estimated_duration_minutes,e.display_order,s.name,c.title,l.title,COALESCE(a.attempt_count,0),a.last_percentage,a.best_percentage,a.last_status FROM public.exercises e JOIN public.subjects s ON s.id=e.subject_id JOIN public.chapters c ON c.id=e.chapter_id JOIN public.lessons l ON l.id=e.lesson_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*)::bigint AS attempt_count,(array_agg(ea.percentage ORDER BY ea.started_at DESC))[1] AS last_percentage,max(ea.percentage) AS best_percentage,(array_agg(ea.status ORDER BY ea.started_at DESC))[1] AS last_status FROM public.exercise_attempts ea WHERE ea.exercise_id=e.id AND ea.user_id=auth.uid()) a ON true WHERE public.can_access_exercise_for_current_student(e.id) AND (p_subject_id IS NULL OR e.subject_id=p_subject_id) AND (p_chapter_id IS NULL OR e.chapter_id=p_chapter_id) AND (p_lesson_id IS NULL OR e.lesson_id=p_lesson_id) AND (p_difficulty IS NULL OR e.difficulty=p_difficulty) ORDER BY e.display_order,e.title; $$; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_exercise_detail(p_exercise_id uuid) RETURNS TABLE(exercise_id uuid,title text,statement text,content_markdown text,exercise_type text,difficulty text,estimated_duration_minutes integer,subject_name text,chapter_title text,lesson_title text,questions jsonb) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$ SELECT e.id,e.title,e.statement,e.content_markdown,e.exercise_type,e.difficulty,e.estimated_duration_minutes,s.name,c.title,l.title,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',q.id,'question_type',q.question_type,'prompt_markdown',q.prompt_markdown,'options',q.options,'display_order',q.display_order) ORDER BY q.display_order,q.created_at) FROM public.exercise_questions q WHERE q.exercise_id=e.id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM public.exercises e JOIN public.subjects s ON s.id=e.subject_id JOIN public.chapters c ON c.id=e.chapter_id JOIN public.lessons l ON l.id=e.lesson_id WHERE e.id=p_exercise_id AND public.can_access_exercise_for_current_student(e.id); $$; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.start_exercise_attempt(p_exercise_id uuid) RETURNS TABLE(attempt_id uuid,exercise_id uuid,status text,started_at timestamptz) LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$ BEGIN IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT public.can_access_exercise_for_current_student(p_exercise_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cet exercice n’est pas disponible pour votre profil scolaire.'; END IF; RETURN QUERY INSERT INTO public.exercise_attempts(user_id,exercise_id) VALUES(auth.uid(),p_exercise_id) RETURNING id,exercise_attempts.exercise_id,exercise_attempts.status,exercise_attempts.started_at; END; $$; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.submit_exercise_attempt(p_attempt_id uuid,p_answers jsonb) RETURNS TABLE(attempt_id uuid,status text,score numeric,percentage numeric,total_questions integer,correct_answers integer,incorrect_answers integer,submitted_at timestamptz,correction_markdown text) LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$ DECLARE v_exercise_id uuid; v_auto_total integer; v_correct integer; v_total integer; v_percentage numeric; v_status text; BEGIN IF jsonb_typeof(p_answers) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Les réponses doivent être fournies sous la forme d’un objet.'; END IF; SELECT exercise_id INTO v_exercise_id FROM public.exercise_attempts WHERE id=p_attempt_id AND user_id=auth.uid() AND status='in_progress'; IF v_exercise_id IS NULL OR NOT public.can_access_exercise_for_current_student(v_exercise_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cette tentative ne peut pas être soumise.'; END IF; SELECT count(*)::integer,count(*) FILTER (WHERE question_type IN ('single_choice','multiple_choice','true_false'))::integer,count(*) FILTER (WHERE question_type IN ('single_choice','multiple_choice','true_false') AND CASE WHEN question_type='multiple_choice' THEN NOT EXISTS ((SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(correct_answers) EXCEPT SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(p_answers -> id::text,'[]'::jsonb))) UNION ALL (SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(p_answers -> id::text,'[]'::jsonb)) EXCEPT SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(correct_answers))) ELSE correct_answers=COALESCE(p_answers -> id::text,'[]'::jsonb) END)::integer INTO v_total,v_auto_total,v_correct FROM public.exercise_questions WHERE exercise_id=v_exercise_id; v_percentage:=CASE WHEN v_auto_total>0 THEN round((v_correct::numeric/v_auto_total::numeric)*100,2) ELSE NULL END; v_status:=CASE WHEN v_auto_total=v_total THEN 'submitted' ELSE 'review_required' END; UPDATE public.exercise_attempts SET answers=p_answers,status=v_status,score=CASE WHEN v_auto_total>0 THEN v_correct ELSE NULL END,percentage=v_percentage,total_questions=v_total,correct_answers=v_correct,incorrect_answers=GREATEST(v_auto_total-v_correct,0),submitted_at=now(),duration_seconds=GREATEST(0,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now()-started_at))::integer) WHERE id=p_attempt_id; RETURN QUERY SELECT a.id,a.status,a.score,a.percentage,a.total_questions,a.correct_answers,a.incorrect_answers,a.submitted_at,e.correction_markdown FROM public.exercise_attempts a JOIN public.exercises e ON e.id=a.exercise_id WHERE a.id=p_attempt_id; END; $$; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_exercise_attempt_result(p_attempt_id uuid) RETURNS TABLE(attempt_id uuid,exercise_id uuid,title text,status text,score numeric,percentage numeric,total_questions integer,correct_answers integer,incorrect_answers integer,started_at timestamptz,submitted_at timestamptz,duration_seconds integer,correction_markdown text,questions jsonb) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$ SELECT a.id,a.exercise_id,e.title,a.status,a.score,a.percentage,a.total_questions,a.correct_answers,a.incorrect_answers,a.started_at,a.submitted_at,a.duration_seconds,e.correction_markdown,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',q.id,'question_type',q.question_type,'prompt_markdown',q.prompt_markdown,'options',q.options,'answer',a.answers -> q.id::text,'explanation_markdown',q.explanation_markdown) ORDER BY q.display_order,q.created_at) FROM public.exercise_questions q WHERE q.exercise_id=e.id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM public.exercise_attempts a JOIN public.exercises e ON e.id=a.exercise_id WHERE a.id=p_attempt_id AND a.user_id=auth.uid() AND a.status<>'in_progress'; $$; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_exercise_history() RETURNS TABLE(attempt_id uuid,exercise_id uuid,title text,status text,percentage numeric,started_at timestamptz,submitted_at timestamptz,best_percentage numeric,attempt_count bigint) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$ SELECT a.id,a.exercise_id,e.title,a.status,a.percentage,a.started_at,a.submitted_at,max(a.percentage) OVER (PARTITION BY a.exercise_id),count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.exercise_id) FROM public.exercise_attempts a JOIN public.exercises e ON e.id=a.exercise_id WHERE a.user_id=auth.uid() AND a.status<>'in_progress' ORDER BY a.submitted_at DESC NULLS LAST,a.started_at DESC; $$; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.can_access_exercise_for_current_student(uuid) FROM PUBLIC,anon; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_my_exercise_catalog(uuid,uuid,uuid,text) FROM PUBLIC,anon; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_my_exercise_detail(uuid) FROM PUBLIC,anon; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.start_exercise_attempt(uuid) FROM PUBLIC,anon; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.submit_exercise_attempt(uuid,jsonb) FROM PUBLIC,anon; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_my_exercise_attempt_result(uuid) FROM PUBLIC,anon; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_my_exercise_history() FROM PUBLIC,anon; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.can_access_exercise_for_current_student(uuid) TO authenticated; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_my_exercise_catalog(uuid,uuid,uuid,text) TO authenticated; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_my_exercise_detail(uuid) TO authenticated; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.start_exercise_attempt(uuid) TO authenticated; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.submit_exercise_attempt(uuid,jsonb) TO authenticated; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_my_exercise_attempt_result(uuid) TO authenticated; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_my_exercise_history() TO authenticated;
